gui.header.subtitle: Edit documents by voice
gui.folders.title: Local Folders
gui.folders.desc: Connected folders are automatically indexed locally (local chunking + embeddings → local search). The original documents are NOT uploaded to the server (organization knowledge base). To share a document with your organization, upload it directly from the chat.

gui.topic.question: What topic should I write about? (e.g., AI governance framework)
gui.prompt.docReport: Use DocxCreate to create a report on {0}. Use template "report"; fill the Overview, Background, Current Status, Analysis, and Conclusion & Recommendations sections with substantive content relevant to the topic, and organize the key points into tables.
gui.prompt.docIncident: Use DocxCreate to create an incident report on {0}. Use template "incident"; fill the Summary, Sequence of Events, Cause, Actions Taken, and Preventive Measures sections.
gui.prompt.docProposal: Use DocxCreate to create a proposal on {0}. Use template "proposal"; fill the Background & Objectives, Proposal Details, Expected Benefits, Timeline, and Budget sections, and present the timeline and budget as tables.
gui.prompt.pptA: Use PptxCreate to create a presentation on {0}. Use template "A" (corporate); include a cover plus key slides (using the section/content/two_col/table layouts as appropriate), filled with topic-relevant titles and concise bullet content.
gui.prompt.pptB: Use PptxCreate to create a presentation on {0}. Use template "B" (keynote); one message per slide with large titles, filling the cover and key slides with topic content.
gui.prompt.pptC: Use PptxCreate to create a presentation on {0}. Use template "C" (minimal); generous whitespace and concise text, filling the cover and key slides with topic content.
gui.prompt.pptD: Use PptxCreate to create a presentation on {0}. Use template "D" (dark); make it impactful, filling the cover and key slides with topic content.
gui.prompt.xlsExpense: Use XlsxCreate to create an expense report form. Use template "expense".
gui.prompt.xlsInvoice: Use XlsxCreate to create an invoice form. Use template "invoice".
gui.prompt.xlsInventory: Use XlsxCreate to create an inventory sheet form. Use template "inventory".
